g.text: An early deep study of surface language and
construction, translating the segmented logic of
medieval armour into a moving metal form.
Medieval knight armour and dark-fantasy references
The central challenge was finding how rigid sheet-
metal segments could connect and still follow the hand.
Joint ideas were tested through repeated cuts, overlaps
Finger components were cut, formed, drilled and linked
by hand. Each trial refined overlap, range of motion
and continuity across the armoured surface.
The resolved gauntlet brings the joint experiments
together as one wearable construction—protective in
expression, but articulated enough to move with the
